ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: Update harvest-worktree.sh to not require test-gate-status/review-status after hook removal

Add done definition: 'harvest-worktree.sh no longer requires test-gate-status or review-status as gate artifacts (lines 158-222), and harvest-attestation-format.md is updated or deprecated accordingly. The --attest flag in record-test-status.sh and record-review.sh is updated or removed in lockstep.' Also explicitly enumerate other consumers updated: ci-llm-review-runner.sh (line 395), health-check.sh (lines 103-104), cleanup-claude-session.sh (lines 170, 593), per-worktree-review-commit.md (Steps 3-4), and the contract doc plugins/dso/docs/contracts/harvest-attestation-format.md.
